mechanisms.NAME: Cost-multiple entry gate
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Take a trade only if StdDev(fuel) >= k1 * roundTripCost AND distanceToTarget >= k2 * roundTripCost (k1=3,k2=4).
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: makes marginal trades unprofitable by construction

mechanisms.NAME: Adaptive tick-window lookback
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Start at 30 ticks and EXPAND the window until it spans >= 1 second (cap 250) before computing velocity/acceleration.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: fixes velocity maths that collapse when gold prints 100+ ticks/s at the NY open

mechanisms.NAME: Rolling p90 spread + spike gate + spread/target ratio in the ranker
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Use a rolling p90 spread, block entries on a spread SPIKE multiple, and carry spread/target cost as a scoring term.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: cost becomes a first-class ranking feature, not a binary filter

mechanisms.NAME: Cost-type-failure test (flat-payoff invariance)
mechanisms.MECHANISM: If per-trade expected payoff is flat across the whole parameter surface, the failure is cost, not alpha: stop.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: cheapest possible kill-test for a promising-looking sweep

mechanisms.NAME: Perold 4-term implementation shortfall incl. Opportunity on the UNFILLED fraction
mechanisms.MECHANISM: IS = Spread + Impact + Fee + Opportunity, where Opportunity = max(0, adverse post-window drift) * UNFILLED fraction.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: retail backtests silently book unfilled size at par (opportunity cost = 0)

mechanisms.NAME: Spread-vs-edge pre-trade hurdle + mid-vs-touch asymmetry
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Publish a per-symbol break-even move (cost hurdle); evaluate every signal at the TOUCH, never only at mid.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: 'inefficient at the mid, efficient at the touch' is a general law

mechanisms.NAME: Reversion-ablation maker/taker classifier
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Drop the mean-reversion features; if IC collapses (0.473 -> 0.177), the edge belongs to the quoter, not the taker.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: classifies whether your signal is a taker edge at all

mechanisms.NAME: Purge + embargo + uniqueness + eligibility censoring + day-level AUC
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Chronological splits, purge/embargo by label window, sample-uniqueness weights, exclude unobservable outcomes, report per-day variability.

mechanisms.NAME: Markout methodology (signed, multi-horizon, with equity)
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Per fill: sell -> p - m(t+h); buy -> m(t+h) - p; report markout alongside equity and inventory, never instead.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: equity can look fine while markout is negative (hidden toxicity)

mechanisms.NAME: FIFO qty_in_front + cancel model + size-aware fill label
mechanisms.MECHANISM: queue_ahead tracked per order; label 'filled' iff cumulative volume at/through price >= queue_ahead + order_size.

mechanisms.NAME: Intensity calibration + overfit ratio
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Fit log(fillRate) = logA - k*spread by OLS; gate every parameter set on OOS_Sharpe / IS_Sharpe.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: turns a free parameter into a measured one; flags overfitting

mechanisms.NAME: Sensitivity parameter published as a first-class result
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Publish the fill-model luck parameter (rho) sweep as an output, not as a hidden constant.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: queue assumptions are the dominant unmodelled risk

mechanisms.NAME: Detect whether your microstructure input is real before using it
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Record has_trade_flags; validate DOM non-degeneracy (constant 50/50 or +-90 jitter = unusable) before it earns weight.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: same conclusion reached from both the DOM and the tick side

mechanisms.NAME: Real-tick-only acceptance + generated-vs-real honesty table
mechanisms.MECHANISM: No tick-scale result is admissible unless it declares 100% real ticks; publish the generated-vs-real delta.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: same build: generated PF 1.97 vs real 0.34 (5.8x overstatement)

mechanisms.NAME: Init-time invariants, slippage abort, virtual-stop persistence, magic isolation
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Refuse to load on illegal parameter combinations; abort a fill worse than N pips; persist virtual SL/TP; scope every position scan by magic+symbol.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: cheap, machine-checkable safety that killed a whole EA generation

mechanisms.NAME: Avoid paying the spread twice: limit exit at the statistical mean
mechanisms.MECHANISM: Enter on the closed bar, exit with a server-side limit at the target so the exit does not cross the spread.
mechanisms.WHY_IT_MATTERS: market-order exits pay the spread on both legs
